metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a fast, simple, and effective technique to help relieve outer (lateral) knee pain—in as little as 30 SECONDS.

This easy-to-follow exercise can be done virtually anywhere, whether you're at home, at the office, or on the go. Best of all, it requires no special equipment, making it perfect for quick relief anytime you need it.

Give it a try and let us know how it works for you!
